name: Digital Figure Iina
summary: Digital Figure Iina tells the story of an alien girl that is send to earth to become a human idol. The player can choose what clothes Iina is going to wear each week and also talk to her to know how she feels. Iina can learn different things to improve her stats, like take photographs sessions, piano lessons, singing lessons, modeling, gymnastic, study, dancing lessons, etc. The game got a time limit of 3 years to reach the goal.

game_localizations.name: デジタルフィギュア イイナ
